entities.summary: Jean-Paul Joseph Gonzalez is a French virologist whose research focuses on pathogen emergence, disease eco-epidemiology, arbovirology and vector-transmitted diseases, and viral hemorrhagic fevers. He graduated from the Medical School of Bordeaux University, France and completed Ph.D. in Viral Molecular Biology and Genetics from the Faculty of science, University of Clermont-Ferrand.
